examples.text: Man konnte die Sterne in der stockdunklen Nacht wunderbar mit dem bloßen Auge betrachten.

glosses: Absolutely dark or black; as dark as pitch.

examples.text: The assassin crept into the royal bedchamber only after it was pitch-dark.
